name: Doreijou
source:
Main character lives alone and has too much spare time on his hands. A certain company has a huge debt to protagonist father's company, and in order to repay the debt they send president daughter of the debtor company to use as he desires. And father brings the girl to protagonist's flat to live with him as a pet.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公独自生活，有着太多无所事事的时间。某家公司欠下主人公父亲的公司巨额债务，为了偿债，对方把总裁的女儿送来，任凭主人公处置。父亲把少女带到主人公的公寓，让她以宠物身份与他共同生活。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
